title: Celsius begins operating
description: Celsius began operating as a crypto lending and interest account platform during the early growth period for centralized crypto yield services.
notes: Launch date is approximate and should be verified against primary company history sources.

title: Withdrawals and transfers paused
description: Celsius announced a pause on withdrawals, swaps, and transfers, citing extreme market conditions.

title: Chapter 11 bankruptcy filed
description: Celsius and affiliated debtors filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection in the Southern District of New York.
notes: Bankruptcy filing anchors the main restructuring period.

title: Reorganization plan confirmed
description: The bankruptcy court confirmed Celsius's plan, setting up distributions to creditors and a transition out of bankruptcy.
notes: Needs direct docket evidence in later pass.

title: Creditor distributions begin after bankruptcy exit
description: Celsius exited bankruptcy and announced that distributions to creditors would begin, including crypto and other recovery components.
notes: Customer outcome depends on claim type.

title: BlockFi begins operating
description: BlockFi began operating as a crypto lender and later became known for interest accounts and lending products.

title: Interest account product becomes central
description: BlockFi's interest account product became one of the most visible centralized crypto yield offerings.
notes: Product history should be expanded later.

title: SEC settlement over BlockFi Interest Accounts
description: BlockFi agreed to a settlement with the SEC and state regulators related to its interest account product.
notes: Important terms and regulatory risk event.

title: Platform activity limited after FTX collapse
description: BlockFi paused or limited activity after the collapse of FTX and related uncertainty over exposure.
notes: Failure-chain event linked to FTX exposure.

title: Chapter 11 bankruptcy filed
description: BlockFi and affiliated debtors filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection after FTX-related disruption.

title: BlockFi emerges from bankruptcy
description: BlockFi announced that it had emerged from bankruptcy and would proceed with wind-down and recovery efforts.
notes: Outcome remains tied to estate recoveries.

title: Voyager begins operating
description: Voyager developed as a crypto brokerage and yield-linked platform offering trading and rewards-related services.

title: Trading, deposits, withdrawals, and rewards suspended
description: Voyager suspended trading, deposits, withdrawals, and loyalty rewards after stress related to exposure to Three Arrows Capital.

title: Chapter 11 bankruptcy filed
description: Voyager Digital and affiliates filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection shortly after the platform suspension.

title: FTX US asset purchase agreement announced
description: Voyager announced an asset purchase agreement with FTX US, which later failed after FTX collapsed.

title: Binance.US sale agreement announced
description: Voyager later announced a proposed Binance.US transaction, which also did not lead to a completed customer migration.

title: Initial customer recovery process begins
description: Voyager began an initial customer recovery process after sale paths failed and the estate moved toward direct distributions.
notes: Recovery percentage and timing should be verified against official estate communications.
